investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Nimforge Trips (travel booking); Platform: on-premises data center DC-East, server range 10.122.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster nimfor-prod (kubeadm); itinerary-api pods run with 8 GiB memory limits; deployments are canary releases with automated analysis; Change management: production changes carry CR- identifiers.
